title: Complete roadmap development tasks: i18n, CLI, deprecation warnings, docs
body:
Addresses open items across all four ROADMAP priority areas (P1–P4).

### Console i18n completion (P2.1)
- Migrate all hardcoded strings in `ErrorBoundary`, `mode-toggle`, `ObjectView` to i18n keys
- Add `console.theme`, `console.objectView`, `console.localeSwitcher` key sections to all 10 locale files
- Create `LocaleSwitcher` component, add to `AppHeader` alongside `ModeToggle`

```tsx
// ErrorBoundary: extracted default fallback as function component to use hooks
function DefaultErrorFallback({ error, onReset }) {
  const { t } = useObjectTranslation();
  return <EmptyTitle>{t('console.errors.somethingWentWrong')}</EmptyTitle>;
}
```

### CLI fixes (P1.4)
- **doctor.ts**: Resolve TODO — check Tailwind content config, add TypeScript version check (5.0+), peer dependency validation, `.ts` config support
- **dev.ts**: Resolve TODO — load `app.json` in fallback pages directory detection
- **check.ts**: Resolve TODO — validate schema `type` against known ObjectUI types

### Deprecation warnings with migration snippets (P1.3)
- `Registry.ts`: namespace deprecation now shows before/after code + migration guide link
- `validation-engine.ts`: function-based condition warning now shows declarative alternative

### README schema examples (P1.1)
- Add 4 copy-paste-ready JSON schemas: contact form, data grid, dashboard, kanban board

### Documentation guides (P4)
- `building-crud-app.md` — end-to-end CRUD tutorial
- `plugin-development.md` — custom plugin creation guide
- `theming.md` — Tailwind/cva/dark mode customization
- `architecture-overview.md` — layer architecture with data flow diagrams
- `troubleshooting.md` — 10 common issues with fixes
- `ci-cd-pipeline.md` — all 13 GitHub Actions workflows documented

### ROADMAP update
- Mark all newly completed items, update audit findings and success metrics
